definition: the time of year for a special activity
description: A sandy beach on a clear sunny morning. Two workers in olive shirts unstack white sun loungers from a tall pile, and closed umbrellas stand in a row by a lifeguard tower. A young woman in a white shirt and orange swimsuit dives through the air onto a lounger, kicking up sand, lands on it and throws one arm up in triumph. A shirtless young man runs up and puts a blue cool box on the lounger next to her, and behind them a group of young people runs across the beach with towels.

taps.target: the man with the cool box
